_comment: Canon match rules (docs/design/04). They are not game options.
_fixed_in_engine: substitutions, injured_player_replaced, sent_off_player_replaced, restart_after_goal, decide_on_goals_if_capped and replay_on_knockout_draw describe behaviour the game hard-codes (no substitutions, the conceding side restarts, a capped match is decided on the score, Competition replays knockout draws); changing them has no effect.
_not_built: snitchnip_forfeits_match, crowd_hex_forfeits_match (no Snitchnip or crowd-hex event exists, so no match ends in a forfeit), timeout_max_minutes_normal/_long (time-outs are instant), night_pause_hours (the pause restores condition but the clock does not skip the night) and sleep_relays_in_long_match are documentation only: nothing reads them yet.
